annotations.text:
YOUR WORK — what changed
One question per card: what do I do next.
Gone: the status legend, the What-you-do-here banner, the stage/system/clock/assignee chip row above every title.
The date and the link now sit ON the card, pre-filled, so nothing is blocked behind a modal.
Try it: pick a date, hit Start, paste a link, Submit.

TO REVIEW — two clicks
Open the work, then Approve or Ask for changes.
Ask for changes opens one box right here — no modal, no separate reject flow, and the Send button only wakes up once you have written the reason.
Try it: Approve one, Ask for changes on another.

ALL VIDEOS — one shape, not a grid
The old tick/cross matrix is now a six-part progress bar per video: green = done, amber = happening now, grey = not open.
Four dropdown filters collapsed into search plus four chips.
Try it: click the chips, type in the search box.

ONE VIDEO — only the open stage
Six stages down the side. Finished ones are a single line. The stage that is yours is the only one that opens with fields.
No more label-and-dash rows for fields that are empty.
Try it: click Recording, paste a link, Submit. Then click Script.
